title: C4OS Grill Question 030 - Clone Repository Registration

questions.label: How should Clone Repository execute?
questions.help: Recommended: through a C4OS Tauri tool that wraps system Git and then registers the destination folder in the current workspace. This keeps clone observable and consistent with tool policy.
options: C4OS Tauri tool wraps system Git, then registers destination folder
Runtime/agent executes git clone through terminal
Frontend invokes a Tauri command directly without tool policy

questions.label: After clone succeeds, what should C4OS do?
questions.help: Recommended: add the cloned folder to the current workspace and select it as active.
options: Add cloned folder to current workspace and select it active
Add cloned folder but keep current project active
Prompt whether to add cloned folder
Only reveal cloned folder in file manager

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify approval policy, destination validation, duplicate folders, existing non-empty folders, branch selection, or credential prompts.
